add.title: Add a repository
add.intro: Paste a github.com or gitlab.com repository URL — DevDigest clones it locally and imports open pull requests. API keys aren’t needed here; set them once in <link>Settings → API Keys</link>.
add.footer: API keys live in Settings · <kbd>esc</kbd> to close

errors.unsupported_repo_host: Only github.com and gitlab.com repository URLs are supported.
errors.gitlab_token_missing: Add a GitLab access token in Settings → API Keys before adding a gitlab.com repository.
errors.gitlab_token_invalid: The GitLab access token was rejected. Update it in Settings → API Keys.
errors.gitlab_project_inaccessible: This GitLab project can’t be accessed with the configured token. Check the URL and the token’s access.
